text: [low, gravelly] Nine a.m. [pause] The kid is waiting for a man he's never met. [sighs] Again.
[whispering dreamily] He said he's coming today... [sighs lovingly]
[gasps] [squealing with joy] HE'S ON HIS WAY! [sobbing happily] He's on his waaay!
[low, gravelly] Seven hours. No food. No shower. [pause] No blinking.
[screaming excitedly] I'M HERE! I'M COMING! I'M HEEERE!
[strained, through gritted teeth] Thirty seconds. [panting] Nobody comes in thirty seconds.
[low, gravelly] [sighs] Same window. Same time. [pause] Tomorrow.
